scope_note: Covers a Scottish public authority's power to refuse a request on grounds of excessive cost under FOISA, the money limit, and how the cost is calculated. Limited to legislation; Scottish Information Commissioner decisions are out of scope.

steps.title: Find the power to refuse for excessive cost
steps.detail: Retrieve section 12 of the Freedom of Information (Scotland) Act 2002 and establish whether it sets an amount itself or leaves it to regulations.

steps.title: Find the prescribed amount
steps.detail: Follow section 12(1) into the regulations made under it and retrieve the provision that sets the figure.

steps.title: Establish how the cost is calculated
steps.detail: Retrieve the provision defining projected costs, what may be counted, and any cap on staff time.

steps.title: Note the procedural duty
steps.detail: Establish what the authority must do, and by when, when it relies on the excessive cost provision.
